public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. Stanford reports strong generative AI investment growth in 2025, while October reporting describes a severe Chinese AI and semiconductor stock correction. Neither establishes the broad collapse specified in the contract. Continued investment also cannot disprove an eventual collapse. No decisive event meeting the early-resolution rule was established.
limitations: The result depends partly on reading the claim as a broad sector forecast rather than a prediction about any regional correction.
The Chinese market evidence is a secondary summary because the original Reuters report could not be read.
Annual investment data lag current market conditions.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The generative AI boom is unsustainable and will ultimately collapse.

statement.excerpt: I believe that the artificial intelligence boom — which would be better described as a generative AI boom — is (as I've said before) unsustainable, and will ultimately collapse.

our_interpretation: Collapse means a broad, sustained contraction in the generative AI sector, visible across financing, investment and business activity.
An isolated company failure or a regional stock-market decline does not by itself establish collapse of the boom described.
No numerical threshold, geographic boundary or deadline was supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence establishes a broad, sustained collapse of generative AI financing, investment and business activity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Continued growth for a finite period cannot contradict an eventual collapse with no deadline. Contradiction would require evidence that decisively rules out the claimed necessity of collapse.

evidence.explanation: Investment expanded substantially in 2025. This weighs against a collapse during that year but cannot disprove an eventual collapse or establish conditions in October 2026.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The Chinese stock index STAR50'
evidence.explanation: This is evidence of a substantial regional market correction. Its geography and inclusion of semiconductor companies prevent treating it as decisive evidence that the broader generative AI boom collapsed.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Corroborated evidence of a broad, sustained generative AI contraction across financing, investment and business activity would support the forecast. Mere passage of time without collapse cannot contradict its unlimited horizon.
